syl: ᏧᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᏍᏆ ᏃᎴ ᏧᎾᏣᎧᏎᎴ ᎦᎾᎪᎢ.
pho: tsuni:ní:yvhe sgina tsí:sgwa nole tsuni:tságse:le'i ganhgó:'i.
eng: they caught the bird and cut off its tongue.

syl: ᎯᎪᎢᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᏯᎪᎦ ᏍᏆᎳ ᎦᎾᎪᎢ
pho: hí:go:'í:ga hí'a tsí:sgwa gahygó:ga sgwalá: ganhgó:'i
eng: Even today the titmouse has a short tongue,

syl: ᏃᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᎭᏂᎧᏔ ᎦᏯᎪᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
pho: nole hí'a ani:tsalagi haníktaha gahygó:ga gesv´:'i.
eng: and the Cherokees know it is a liar.
